# DELETE /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}/{version}

Delete a specific version of a package

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-202`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| type | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |
| version | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks write access to packages
- **404** — Package version not found
- **500** — Internal error during deletion

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | context.PackageAssignmentAPI | controller | Resolve user by username; Determine access mode; Get version by name and version; Build PackageDescriptor with files, properties, metadata |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | packages.DeletePackageVersion | controller | Call RemovePackageVersion service |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | packages_service.RemovePackageVersion | service | Get PackageDescriptor; Call specialization OnBeforeRemovePackageVersion; In transaction: delete version properties, file properties, files, version; Notify PackageDelete |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access requires at least read permission; write operations require write access or site admin | authorization | ctx.Package.AccessMode < accessMode && !ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() |
| Package version deletion defers blob cleanup to cron task - blobs are NOT deleted immediately | business_logic | Always on version deletion |
| Specialization hook called before removing package version for type-specific cleanup | business_logic | Before any deletion |
| PackageAssignmentAPI middleware resolves package descriptor including files when version is in path | business_logic | version path param is not empty |
